thread:
rachel_devex: Heads up: noticed JS SDK still surfaces a generic HTTPError for 403/401 while Python and Go return typed AuthError/AuthPermission. New users hit the quickstart and see an opaque error.

yang_sdk: Hmm, we intentionally unified to HTTPError for v1 to avoid explosion of types, but that was before we added retry_hint. We should at least normalize commonly actionable codes -> typed errors.

emma_samples: This shows up in sample-app flow where we call /v1/embed during onboarding. The UI shows the red banner 'Request failed' with no hint. First-time devs file support tickets for "service down" instead of auth setup.

paul_support: Can we prioritize 401/403/429 mappings? Those are 80% of our low-effort support chats. If the SDK provides a retryable flag and a short user_facing string, we can update sample-app quickly.

yang_sdk: Proposal: map server status to error classes + metadata. Minimal shape for SDK Error object we want across languages: `name` (string), `status` (int), `code` (string), `message` (string), `retryable` (bool), `retry_hint` (string|null), `user_message` (string|null). Example: 401 -> {name: 'AuthError', status:401, code:'invalid_token', retryable:true, retry_hint:'refresh_token', user_message:'Signed out — tap to sign in.'}

rachel_devex: Love that. Keep user_message short, copy-owned. We'll centralize copy in docs so sample-apps can import.

emma_samples: Small sample-app change: catch errors and show snackbars for user_message when present. For RateLimit show countdown using Retry-After header. For AuthError call `auth.beginInteractiveSignIn()` instead of modal.

yang_sdk: Implementation notes: JS SDK currently throws instance of HTTPError with properties `status` and `body`. I'll add a compatibility layer in errors.ts that inspects `status` and `body.error.code` -> instantiate specific classes AuthError / PermissionError / RateLimitError / InternalError. Also attach `user_message` via lookup table keyed by error.code or status.

paul_support: Can we ensure 403 -> PermissionError and include guidance like "Insufficient API role: request 'inference.user' scope"? Support gets these often.

yang_sdk: Yes. For 403 we'll surface `code: 'insufficient_scope'` when that header is present. Otherwise generic PermissionError.

emma_samples: Tests to add: unit tests for mapping (401 -> AuthError), sample-app e2e that simulates 429 with Retry-After and verifies UI countdown. Also ensure Python and JS parity tests assert same error.code strings.

rachel_devex: Copy owners: assign to me. I'll provide canonical short strings for user_message and a tiny table of recommended UI behaviors in docs.

yang_sdk: I'll open PR for JS SDK: add errors layer, mapping table, and two unit tests. Also add a small changelog entry advising breaking change? We try to keep compatibility by having HTTPError remain a base class that AuthError inherits from.

lint-bot: [style-bot] New file errors.ts added in branch feature/errors-mapping (#7567). Lint OK.

yang_sdk: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pull/7567 - includes mappings + docs link. Requesting review from @rachel_devex and @emma_samples.

paul_support: Great. From a support metrics POV, if this cuts 'service down' tickets during onboarding by half that's huge. Please add a small note to the onboarding troubleshooting page explaining "401 during quickstart usually means missing API key or expired token" with next steps.

emma_samples: Done — sample-app updated to show contextual UI and the onboarding README has the troubleshooting blurb.

yang_sdk: CI passed, merged, release v1.5.0-rc1. I left HTTPError as base for backwards compatibility; new typed classes are subclasses. Backwards compatible property support: old callers can still check `.status` and `.body`.

rachel_devex: Closing loop: copy landed in docs, sample-app demos updated, and I recorded a 40s clip showing the improved UX for the release notes. Assigning a one-week watch to @paul_support to track ticket volume.

paul_support: Will monitor and report numbers next Tue. Thanks team. :smile:
